== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Dagobah-D-commandernemet-PC-Errata-disc-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Commander Nemet (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): Same words. This is a full card image with the printed art, lore and title and the text box set again; there is no “E”, and a small round bronze disc sits at the bottom right, beside the game-text box.

The 2017 slip and the same area of the disc image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
